overview: The committee addressed a 1967 deed restriction that forced the elimination of several design options and the adoption of modified site plans. The meeting also included a review of MSBA feedback and updated project cost estimates for the remaining high school building scenarios.

items.title: Approval of Minutes and Amendment
items.summary: Approved the April 27 meeting minutes and a motion to amend them to include the full meeting agenda for the record.

items.title: Deed Restriction and Design Option Modifications
items.summary: Eliminated options C2.2, C3.4, and D2.1 due to building restrictions on land owned by the DCR and formally adopted modified alternatives C2.2a and C3.4a. The committee discussed the Article 97 legislative process required to lift such restrictions and heard public concern regarding project oversight and construction impacts.

items.title: MSBA Preliminary Design Program (PDP) Feedback
items.summary: Reviewed feedback from the MSBA, which included a request for a standalone grades 9-12 cost option to distinguish core school costs from district offices and community programs. The committee discussed the necessity of planning for any potentially unhoused programs if they are removed from the final project scope.

items.title: Preferred Schematic Report (PSR) Cost Estimate Review
items.summary: Evaluated updated total project cost estimates, noting that code upgrade costs rose to $528 million while some new construction options saw cost reductions due to space efficiencies. The project team explained that eliminating modular classrooms in several options resulted in better long-term cost outcomes despite construction phasing complexities.
